extensions.name: pi-agent-ext-hermes-memory
extensions.fullReason: Was FULL due to deep pi-ai/* subpath imports + better-sqlite3 native addon. Switched to THIN after the Bun.resolveSync fix (criterion 1) — deep subpaths now resolve, and better-sqlite3 stays as a residual bare specifier (same as FULL).

extensions.name: pi-agent-ext-subagents
extensions.fullReason: Thin because the extension imports @earendil-works/pi-ai/compat (deep subpath) + jiti (runtime TS loader for child processes) — both resolve as residual bare specifiers under thin, same as hermes-memory's pi-ai/* deep imports. 85+ source modules make FULL bundling expensive; thin lets the workspace node_modules resolve them.

extensions.name: pi-agent-ext-workflow
extensions.fullReason: Thin because the extension imports compiled ../src/index.js which pulls in @earendil-works/pi-ai/* deep subpaths + acorn — all resolve as residual bare specifiers under thin. Was previously lazy-only (opt-in via -e workflow); promoted to eager (default-enabled) 2026-07-10. The lazyExtensions aliases below are kept for backwards-compat (scripts/docs still pass -e workflow); the SDK loader dedups the resulting duplicate path so there is no double-load.
extensions.testGate: cd bun-apps/pi-agent-ext-workflow && bun run build && bun test
